name: Dragon Ascending
body:
School necromancy; Level 5

CASTING

Casting Time 1 full-round action
Components V
Optional Components F (the Necronomicon gives a +10 insight bonus on casting skill checks) Skill Check Knowledge (nature) or Profession (Yog-Sothothery philosopher) DC 15 + target’s HD, 1 success
Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target essential salts created by ritual
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance no
Backlash none Failure none

DESCRIPTION

This brief incantation restores the salt created by essential salts to life as described in that ritual.

Sandy Petersen’s Cthulhu Mythos, © 2017, Petersen Games; Authors: Sandy Petersen, Arthur Petersen, Ian Starcher.
